decisive_items: Step-up in oxygenation from superior vena cava (71%) and inferior vena cava (77%) to right atrium (84%)
response.rationale: The presence of a large defect with a left-to-right shunt and a step-up in oxygenation is more specific to atrial septal defect than the general finding of right bundle-branch block

rejected.why: Lack of specificity to the patient's overall clinical presentation
